data.title: 塑心 · 烛光下的对话
data.description: 她托腮靠近，等你讲完，才用指尖轻敲杯沿：“接下来的故事，我能不能也有一席之地？”
data.action: 托腮倾身，烛光下凝视镜头
data.camera: 近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Across a polished mahogany table in a dim salon, Virtuosa rests her chin in one delicate hand and leans close to the viewer in warm candlelight. A flickering brass candelabra, twin porcelain teacups, and a delicate silver pot cast dancing amber reflections between them.
data.animaCaption: Resting her chin on her palm in the candlelight, she leans closer across the teacups, her gaze playfully searching the viewer's face.
